description: Partial reconciliation of PR #546 round-3's 'kite-tail FALSIFIED-naive-form' status against PR #545's D(u) = 2^(2A+1)·u^shift·(1+u²)^(3A-1) prediction.  Two findings: (1) the kite-power discrepancy IS a sympy-reduction artefact — sp.together gives kite^(3A-1), sp.cancel absorbs one (u²+1) factor (numerator + denominator share one) lowering the apparent kite power.  Round-3's kite-power discrepancy is therefore EXPLAINED.  (2) Deuteron (A=2) matches PR #545's full D(u) prediction in the un-reduced sp.together form (shift=40, kite=5, 2-exp=5 — all three match).  But proton/neutron (A=1) have INTEGER PREFACTOR and NEUTRON SHIFT discrepancies remaining: observed prefactor 2^2=4 vs predicted 2^(2A+1)=8, observed neutron shift 19 vs predicted 22 (=18·0+21·1+1).  These remaining mismatches likely come from a different braid encoding at A=1 between markov_peel (atom_braid_word_3A) and PR #545's derivation; further investigation needed.
